pages.text: Villagers who come to pray are $(l)believers$(). During game time $(l)2000 to 9000$() (about dawn to afternoon) they take turns at the prayer spots around the altar, once each per day, about 30 seconds each.$(br2)A prayer only counts if the believer walked at least $(l)8 blocks$() from their own bed. Gods do not accept devotion from villagers shut in a box.
Each extra believer adds favor, but less and less. Today's believers across all villages you are devoted to are counted together, up to $(l)24$(). Roughly:
$(li)1-4: about 3.5-7 × coefficient per day$(li)4-9: about 7-10.5 × coefficient$(li)9-16: about 10.5-14 × coefficient$(li)16-24: about 14-17 × coefficient

For example: a Naiskos with 4 believers gives about $(l)10$() favor a day; a Prostyle Temple with 7, about $(l)18$(). Actual income follows attendance.$(br2)In rain, an open altar (no acropolis yet) yields half; roofed temples are unaffected. Favor stops at the cap; skipping time by command or by sleeping does not count as prayer time.
